mainEntity.name: Will a living room addition increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: A well-designed and constructed living room addition can significantly increase your home's market value, especially if it adds functional living space that aligns with neighborhood demand. However, the return on investment can vary based on the quality of the addition, the local real estate market, and if the addition is proportionate to the rest of the home. We help clients design additions that offer strong appeal and value.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a well-designed living room addition can increase home value, especially if it adds functional space that meets local demand. ROI depends on quality and market.
